{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build

  typecheck:
    name: Typechecker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run typecheck

  linter:
    name: Linter
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run lint

  format:
    name: Code Formatter
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run format

  test:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun test

  exports:
    name: Verify Exports
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Cache bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run exports",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in every one of its six jobs, repeatedly fetching dependencies with no cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by measured literature evidence (vm time reduction: free 6%, paid 3.4%) and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable across the jobs, the lockfile is implied by `--frozen-lockfile`, and no equivalent cache already exists. Adding a lockfile-keyed bun dependency cache before each install preserves all jobs, steps, and required checks while reducing repeated install time. No permissions, secrets, deployment, or new external network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
